Early spring brings a smooth watch
Praise for the whole team
Care in motion at Aurelia Skyways

The Companion Animal Travel Desk kept its usual steady pace this week, with booking notes, carrier checks, and handoff details all moving in step. The welcome team stayed ready for boarding, and the desk kept communication clear, respectful, and quick, which helped travelers feel informed and pets feel settled. Small problems were caught early, and routine follow-up made the whole process look easy.

That calm finish matters, because care at Aurelia Skyways starts well before departure and continues through pickup. Good teamwork showed in every handoff, from first contact to the final check. When the desk stays alert and courteous, the result is a smoother trip for everyone.
